A basic comparison between base Tachyon and TLT. This assumes that every turn, Tachyon plays 1 one-shot, uses her power to discard the top card of her deck, and then draws one card. TLT plays 1 one-shot, uses her power to draw a card, and then draws a second card.

Start:                  4/0            4/0

After turn 4:        4/8            8/4

I posted this over there, but I think the review really captures the strongest weakness of the App, and that is players that are new to Sentinels when they get the app.

 

Even a good tutorial on how to play the game isn't going to help you learn the heroes, and playing Sentinels solo is a horrible way to learn the game.

Second to that an app will never put the physical deck in your hand where you can look through the deck, pair up cards and get a real feeling for how the deck should work.

When you play the game with no experience, controlling 4 heroes against a Villain you don't know and an environment you don't know you end up with reactions like the review had.  Things like:

Damage is all that matters.

X hero is worthless, or X hero is the best ever.

Fanatic is a healer!  (I've read three different reviews that said that one)

This game needs a healer!

and my favorite:

This game lacks strategy or meaningful choices.

 

There isn't an easy solution to this, things like a deck viewer might help, but not like having cards in your hand, and the implementation probably isn't worth it for the amount of value it would add.  Tutorials for each hero would be ridiculous and eat so much space, the best way to learn is to play one hero several times with your friends.

This app is amazing for people who love Sentinels and want to play it when they wouldn't be able to normally. because it takes away the work of playing solo, does the fiddlyness for you, which gives you a chance to play SotM on your lunch break or on the bus or a road trip, it is awesome.  The implementation is superb from what I've seen so far.

I'm sure we will get some people who see the beauty of the game and slog through the learning process on the app to really get to know the game, but overall the card game with people who know the game already is a far superior introduction.
